title: Should You Add Points to a Marriott Free Night Award?
caption:
Already hold a Marriott Free Night Award? Add points only when the better stay earns them—skip the top-up when the certificate alone works.

Marriott allows up to 25,000 added points. That’s a ceiling, not an assignment. The certificate’s point cap isn’t cash.

Check eligible standard-room availability, expiration, resort fees, and another realistic use of the certificate before it expires. Your extra points have other uses, too. This is redemption math—not a reason to get or renew a card.

Full guide: https://practicalrewards.com/blog/should-you-add-points-to-a-marriott-free-night-award-2994bb.html
Marriott’s rule: https://www.marriott.com/loyalty/redeem/free-night-award-redemption.mi
